# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Dock, depot and mine hands advertise free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold], Western Habitation Complex, upper level, dry most of the year. Shared shower, no pets, no fuel cans in the room. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], quiet room near the spaceport for a freight clerk on the night manifest. Will trade cooking for rent. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]CARGO HANDS WANTED[/bold] at Depot AC-170. Lifter certificate preferred. Rain gear issued, boots are your own problem. - [bold]COOLANT TECHNICIAN[/bold] sought for the processor night shift. Must pass the Company check and keep a steady hand on the valves. - [bold]TMCC OUTPOST[/bold] is short of drill crew again. Ask the foreman, and ask him why.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]WATER PUMP PARTS[/bold], seals and impellers, pulled from a working unit. Trade for ration chits or a good lamp. - [bold]RAIN CAPES[/bold], heavy plastic, stitched by hand. Ten credits, or two for a bottle of anything that is not Weymart water.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: orange tabby, answers to Bilge, last seen under the LZ2 fuel lines. Reward offered.
## Notices - Loans arranged, no forms, no questions. Ask at the bar after the second shift. [italic](The Herald prints every notice it is handed. We advise you not to answer this one.)[/italic] - The NSPA desk reminds residents that the jungle past the north comms tower is out of bounds after dark.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
